# PHPBench fixture provenance

`phpbench-output-success-2000.txt` is captured output from the pinned PHPBench
0.8.1 PTS `patched2` source, executed with `-i 2000` in the AlmaLinux 9.8
Crucible client/server image using PHP 8.0.30. The nondeterministic system and
date lines were normalized; the native test rows, summary, and score were left
as captured. The full unmodified stdout and stderr remain under the local
`local-tests/phpbench/native-probes/` evidence directory and are not part of the
benchmark source repository.
